items.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Joseph Daley with me today. Welcome. [INTERVIEWEE] It’s a pleasure to be here, and thank you very much for this opportunity.
